title: Vitrine
tagline: Vitrine is the Web3 User Profile. It aggregates all different types of assets from different chains and metaverse apps
description: This is the Web3 User profile. All user assets are now separated onto different chains and platform. And we built a profile aggregator. Who doesn't want to show your Axies, Decentralands and gitcoin donations at a same place? It's like your Twitter page for Web3, where in Web2, all your assets online are content; now, you have various types of assets on different chains and open platforms.
how_its_made: We use RSS3(https://rss3.io/) as the major data structure, which uses IPFS. All relationship between users are stored with IPFS as well. Getting things work on Ronin is a bit tricky but it works for now. Definitely needs more work in the future. Frontend is mostly done by Vue, probably need to redo since a lot of shitty frameworks were involved for boosting the progress.
